```{r}
install.packages("recticulate")
library(recticulate) 
library(rvest) 
library(chromote)
library(httr2)
library(tidyverse)

Sys.setenv(CHROMOTE_CHROME ="C:/Program Files/Google/Chrome/Application/chrome.exe")

imbd_2025 <- read_html_live("https://www.imdb.com/list/ls569166685/")
```

```{r}

film_name_test <- imbd_2025 |>
  html_elements("h4.ipc-title__text") |>
  html_text2()

film_name_test_2 <- imbd_2025 |>
  html_elements(xpath = "/html/body/div/main/div/section/div/section/div/div/section/div/ul/li/div/div/div/div/div/div/ul/div/a/h4") |>
  html_text2()

Duration_film_test <- imbd_2025 |>
  html_elements(xpath = "/html/body/div/main/div/section/div/section/div/div/section/div/ul/li/div/div/div/div/div/div/ul/li[2]") |>
  html_text2()

Rate_film_test <- imbd_2025 |>
  html_elements(xpath = "/html/body/div/main/div/section/div/section/div/div/section/div/ul/li/div/div/div/div/div/span/div/span/span[1]") |>
  html_text2()

Votes_film_test <- imbd_2025 |>
  html_elements(xpath = "/html/body/div/main/div/section/div/section/div/div/section/div/ul/li/div/div/div/div/div/span/div/span/span[2]") |>
  html_text2()

Films <- data_frame(Film_name = film_name_test_2,
                    Duration = Duration_film_test,
                    Rate = Rate_film_test,
                    Votes = Votes_film_test)
write.csv(Films, "Films.csv", row.names = F)
```

```{r}
library(rio)
Data <- import("Films.csv")
```
